_comment: Ground truth for src/utils/person-name-validator.js — the mint gate every person passes through.
Names in `must_pass` are REAL, taken from the live corpus (probate decedents, heirs, canonical persons).
Names in `must_reject` are the junk classes the gate exists to stop: OCR phrase fragments, ledger
boilerplate, jurisdictions, and legal roles minted as people.
Both directions are load-bearing. A false ACCEPT mints a non-person (the May-2026 audit deleted 3,271).
A false REJECT silently destroys evidence and is INVISIBLE, because the rejected row never exists to be
audited — that is how 87 real probate decedents were lost before Aug 2026. Add real corpus examples here
when a class is found; never hardcode expectations into the validator or a scraper.

must_pass.name: A. S. Bacon
must_pass.why: initials A. and S. — 'A.' must not read as the article 'a'

must_pass.name: D. I. Dawson
must_pass.why: initial I. must not read as the pronoun 'i'

must_pass.name: H. A. Bacon
must_pass.why: two initials, one of them A.

must_pass.name: Hannah Byrd
must_pass.why: surname whose only vowel is y

must_pass.name: Thomas Bacon Sr.
must_pass.why: generational suffix must not reject the name

must_pass.name: Mrs. Eunice Miller Ashmore
must_pass.why: honorific — the main way probate records name women

must_pass.name: Capt. John Smith
must_pass.why: honorific that is also a ledger abbreviation

must_pass.name: Jack
must_pass.why: single given name — legitimate for enslaved persons, must still mint

must_pass.name: Jane Amaranthia
must_pass.why: uncommon given name, heir named in a 1810 will

must_pass.name: Wm. F. King
must_pass.why: Wm = William, vowel-less period abbreviation ubiquitous in probate hands

must_pass.name: Jacobus Van Dyck
must_pass.why: Dutch particle surname, y-only vowel in Dyck

must_reject.name: A. S.
must_reject.why: initials alone are not a discrete identity

must_reject.name: Mrs Sandiford's four daughters
must_reject.why: names a CLASS of heirs, not an individual (audit rule 5: real or absent)

must_be_suspect.name: Albany
must_be_suspect.why: county it was filed in, minted 5x as an assertable enslaver (Jul-2026 NY audit)

must_be_suspect.name: John 1842
must_be_suspect.why: residual digits — a date or liber-folio reference

must_not_be_suspect.name: Jack
must_not_be_suspect.why: single given name is NOT suspect — enslaved single-names must mint

must_not_be_suspect.name: Mrs. Eunice Miller Ashmore
must_not_be_suspect.why: honorific does not make a name suspect

must_not_be_suspect.name: John Smith Esquire
must_not_be_suspect.why: only SOME tokens are role words
